:::

M4's closed-loop check runs the coupled simulation once with the transport surrogate and once
with TGLF, the turbulence code it was trained on, and compares the temperature profiles. The
limit is 15%. ITER passes ([served-face T_e 7.42%, T_i 8.18%, both passing the 15% limit; whole profile 7.72/9.23%; 34 of 51 final-state faces served]{.claim}[C-178](/Blog/tokamak-toolkit/claims.qmd#c-178){.cid .st-measured}) and MAST-U fails ([served-face T_e 35.33%, T_i 49.15%, both failing 15%; whole profile 41.51/62.39%; cells with both adjacent faces served give 11.86/23.24%, still failing T_i; 13 of 26 final-state faces served]{.claim}[C-179](/Blog/tokamak-toolkit/claims.qmd#c-179){.cid .st-measured}). The
MAST-U remediation retrained the surrogate. It then stopped at the step that needs a TGLF
reference trajectory to compare the retrained candidate with. At some MAST-U states TGLF
returns negative heat diffusivities, which the guard rejects, so those faces of the reference
use the fallback transport model instead. Refining TGLF's numerical settings did not converge
those values (entries 59–62, last [entry 62](62-width-search-range-controls-the-flux.qmd)).

## The projected reference

For the reference only, the owner chose TGLF at its standard settings with every negative heat
diffusivity set to zero, each projection logged, and a stop if any projected heat flux reaches
1 gB (the gyro-Bohm flux unit) ([OQ-38](/Blog/tokamak-toolkit/decisions.qmd#oq-38)). The production surrogate and guard were unchanged. The
single approved run stopped on that limit and saved no trajectory.

To see whether a rerun could pass, we applied the same rule, read-only, to every face of the
40 saved states of the earlier unprojected reference run, which has identical profiles:

| quantity | result |
|---|---|
| projections, and those reaching the stop | [150 negative raw heat diffusivities at 19 faces; 46 would reach the 1 gB stop, at 31 of 40 states, the first at state 1]{.claim}[C-240](/Blog/tokamak-toolkit/claims.qmd#c-240){.cid .st-measured} |
| of those, on faces the reference would serve | [26 would be served, the first at state 4 (faces 11 and 12, ion, −8.0 and −33.8 gB); near the axis the projected magnitude reaches 6020 gB]{.claim}[C-241](/Blog/tokamak-toolkit/claims.qmd#c-241){.cid .st-measured} |
| candidate against the guarded reference where both serve TGLF | [T_e 32.0%, T_i 41.5% on the 14 faces where both serve TGLF, against the 15% limit]{.claim}[C-242](/Blog/tokamak-toolkit/claims.qmd#c-242){.cid .st-measured} |

The stop applies to every projection, served or not, and the first one to reach it comes at
state 1 (first table row). So the rule cannot complete on this scenario, and no rerun can produce
the reference. Even counting only served faces, it would stop early. The screen is not a
replay: its fluxes are inferred by inverting TORAX's conversion, and a projected run would
leave the saved trajectory after its first served projection. The last row compares against the
guarded TGLF/fallback hybrid, so it describes the distance and is not a gate result.

## Decision

The owner chose the recommended option of [OQ-42](/Blog/tokamak-toolkit/decisions.qmd#oq-42), limited MAST-U scope:
- the MAST-U closed-loop comparison is recorded as not evaluable;
- MAST-U is certified at the M4 review with that limitation stated, with ceilings [K-030](/Blog/tokamak-toolkit/ceilings.qmd#k-030) and
  [K-032](/Blog/tokamak-toolkit/ceilings.qmd#k-032);
- ITER's measured pass stands;
- the model, the guard, the temperature and flux acceptance limits and the frozen data splits
  are unchanged;
- no further MAST-U reference compute is planned.

The other two options were to redefine the comparison against the guarded hybrid, which the
last row suggests would still fail the limit, or to raise the stop threshold, rejected because
projected magnitudes reach thousands of gB.

Where this stands: M4 moves on to the formal proofs, calibration, the EC closed-loop
comparison, certificate-bound guards and the per-surrogate reports, then the certification
review.

Technical details → [verification](../technical/verification.qmd#mastu-scope). Decisions →
[OQ-38](/Blog/tokamak-toolkit/decisions.qmd#oq-38), [OQ-42](/Blog/tokamak-toolkit/decisions.qmd#oq-42).
